label: Country
definition: The country whose budget the line is in, as a three-letter code (KEN is Kenya).

label: Year
definition: The year the fiscal year starts in. A 2024/25 budget that starts in April 2024 is 2024.

label: Subject
values: a Level 2 label in the subject taxonomy
definition: What the money is for, as the taxonomy's name for primary_subject_id.

label: US$
definition: The latest figure held for the line, in US dollars: audited if there is one, else actual, released, revised, appropriated or proposed. Converted at the IMF annual average rate for the year the fiscal year starts in. Blank where no rate is held.

label: Admin head
definition: The top level the budget allocates money to, usually a ministry or vote, as the document names it.

label: Spending entity
definition: The body that spends the money, as the document names it. Often the same as the admin head.

label: Programme
definition: The programme the line sits in, as the document names it. Where a budget has no programmes, the next level it prints; programme_level says which.

label: Sub-programme
definition: The sub-programme, where the document prints one.

label: Line
definition: The name of the budget line as the document prints it.

label: Purpose
definition: What the line pays for, in our words.

label: Line ID
definition: A unique key for the line in one fiscal year: the country, the year and the line's codes.

label: Level of state
definition: The part of the state whose budget holds the line: central government, a province, a state-owned enterprise, a levy-funded fund or a regulator.

label: Tier
definition: The tier of government the document files the line under, where it prints tiers (Mozambique's central and provincial levels).

label: Fiscal year
definition: The fiscal year as the state writes it (2024/25, Exercice 2024, FY2025).

label: Fiscal year start
definition: The first day of the fiscal year.

label: Fiscal year end
definition: The last day of the fiscal year.

label: Calendar
definition: The calendar the state's fiscal year is set in. Dates in this file are Gregorian either way.

label: Budget version
definition: The latest version of the budget the line's figures come from: the original law, a revised budget, or the Nth supplementary budget.

label: Supplementary basis
definition: How a revised or supplementary figure is stated: a restated total that replaces the original, or an increment added to it. Lines marked unclear are left out of totals.

label: Admin head code
definition: The admin head's code as the document prints it.

label: Spending entity code
definition: The spending entity's code as the document prints it.

label: Programme code
definition: The programme's code as the document prints it.

label: Sub-programme code
definition: The sub-programme's code as the document prints it.

label: Economic class
definition: The economic classification the document gives the line, such as goods and services or capital.

label: Admin head basis
definition: Whether admin_head is the document's own name (printed) or worked out from what the line holds (derived).

label: Programme basis
definition: Whether programme is the document's own name (printed) or worked out from what the line holds (derived).

label: Programme level
values: programme, project, activity, action, chapter, line, account, body, vote
definition: The level of the budget that the programme column holds.

label: Scope
definition: Whether the whole line is digital, part of it is (the digital part cannot be separated), or it is unclear.

label: Scope basis
definition: Why the line was judged digital, in our words.

label: Origin
definition: Whose money it is. Every line here is the state's own money; externally financed lines are in the non-state finance dataset.

label: Funding source
definition: The source the document names for the money: tax revenue, domestic borrowing, a body's own fees and levies, the state's counterpart to a donor project, or not stated.

label: Transfer
definition: Whether the line is a transfer to another public body. A transfer is counted once, at the body that spends it.

label: Transfer to
definition: The body that receives a transfer.

label: Currency
definition: The currency of the figures, as a three-letter code.

label: Amount scale
definition: How the document prints its figures (in thousands, in millions). Every figure in this file is in whole units of the currency.

label: Proposed
definition: The figure in the budget bill tabled before parliament.

label: Appropriated
definition: The figure enacted in law.

label: Revised
definition: The figure after an in-year revision or supplementary budget.

label: Released
definition: The figure released to the spending body.

label: Actual
definition: The figure spent in the year (the outturn).

label: Audited
definition: The figure in the audited accounts.

label: Baseline stage
values: proposed, appropriated, revised, released, actual, audited, unclear
definition: The earliest stage a figure is held for.

label: Current stage
values: proposed, appropriated, revised, released, actual, audited, unclear
definition: The latest stage a figure is held for.

label: Spent vs voted
definition: The actual figure as a percentage of the appropriated figure.

label: Spent vs revised
definition: The actual figure as a percentage of the revised figure.

label: Source type
definition: The kind of source the figure comes from.

label: Document type
definition: The kind of budget document, such as appropriation-act or budget-estimates.

label: Where printed
definition: Where in the document the figure is printed: volume, table, page, line.

label: Source
definition: The key of the source document in the Corpus catalogue.

label: Extracted
definition: The date the line was read from the document.

label: Migrated from
definition: For a line carried over from an earlier record rather than read afresh, the key of that record. Blank for a line read from the document.

label: Notes
definition: How the figure was checked against the document's totals, and anything a reader needs to use it.

label: Subject key
values: a key in the subject taxonomy
definition: What the money is for, as a key in the subject taxonomy (dpi.govtech, infra.connect).
